author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Rows of whole chickens roasting slowly over glowing coals — the smell alone feels like home 🔥🌿 In this video, we cook dozens of chickens the traditional village way, turning them slowly over open fire until every piece is perfectly golden and full of smoky flavor.

The skin becomes crispy and beautifully browned while the meat stays juicy and tender inside. Surrounded by firewood, fresh air, and countryside calm, this is rustic outdoor cooking at its most satisfying.

This is authentic village roasting — simple spices, hot coals, and patience doing all the work. A timeless cooking tradition made for family gatherings, shared meals, and unforgettable flavor straight from the fire.
title: Slow Roasted Whole Chickens Over Hot Coals 🔥🌿
